beliefs: f removes all space characters from the input [E1: ' '->'', 'a b'->'cb', 'Hello, World!'->'Jello,World!']
f shifts only the first letter of each string forward by 2 in the alphabet, wrapping at the end [E1: 'a'->'c', 'abc'->'cbc'; E4: 'ab'->'cb', 'aaa'->'caa', 'abcd'->'cbcd', 'cab'->'eab', 'bca'->'dca']
All letters after the first pass through unchanged [E4: 'ab'->'cb', 'abab'->'cbab', 'aaab'->'caab', 'aba'->'cba']
Digits and punctuation pass through unchanged [E1: '123'->'123', '!@#'->'!@#']
The empty string maps to the empty string [E1: ''->'']
Case is preserved on the shifted first letter [E1: 'A'->'C', 'ABC'->'CBC']
